description:
Song Jinju is a low-level employee who drowned in a pool party organized by her company. She awakens and finds herself in the farthest island from the main island, 12 years in the past. Jinju manages to return to the present, but she can't forget the island and the man she met.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_poolin_wz), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54703995), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5128043), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=ycn4), [Qtoon](https://www.qtoon.co.kr/toon/list.mg?tcode=q08z)

**Official Translations:**:   
[English](https://comics.inkr.com/title/1361-pool-in-love), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/78657), [French](https://www.ono.live/webtoon/plongee-dans-le-temps)
